detail.longDescription: # Programming # computers has always felt to me like building castles out of individual grains of sand and pebbles. I don't have the patience for it, and on the few occasions when I have studied enough of a language to write a functional, useful program, I have invariably found myself bored to tears by the tedium of the work. That's why I'm not a coder, despite understanding the basic principles of programming. Instead, I went into systems and network design.
